449:t_1:86.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But is there really a $$バスターマシン$$ on the far side of the moon...?」

449:t_1:87.en:
$$カシオ$$
「I'm absolutely sure. During the chaos at $$Ｄ．Ｏ．Ｍ．Ｅ．#keyword$$, I hacked the $$ムーンレィス$$ databanks and confirmed it.」

449:t_1:89.en:
$$カシオ$$
「It was to find $$トラントロワ$$. I had no choice.」

449:t_1:90.en:
$$ノノ$$
「$$トラントロワ$$... So that's the $$バスターマシン$$'s name.」

449:t_1:91.en:
$$カシオ$$
「It was thought to have sunk twenty years ago in the $$第二次カイパーベルト会戦$$.」

449:t_1:92.en:
$$カシオ$$
「There are several other machines like it. I've been tracking them down on my own.」

449:t_1:93.en:
$$ノノ$$
「To think it's on the far side of the moon...」

449:t_1:94.en:
$$カシオ$$
「It's probably because of the $$時空震動$$. I was surprised to find it near $$メガネビュラ$$ too.」

449:t_1:95.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Well... Without all this chaos, we could never get into an area the $$ムーンレィス$$ control.」

449:t_1:97.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Let's go. I'm sure $$トラントロワ$$ is waiting for us.」

449:t_2:5.en:
$$ノノ$$
「It's a $$バスターマシン$$... But it's broken...」

449:t_2:8.en:
$$カシオ$$
「You can still fight. Alongside me, just like that day.」

449:t_2:9.en:
$$ノノ$$
「What!? You're going to pilot it, $$カシオ$$!?」

449:t_2:10.en:
$$カシオ$$
「I once thought a $$バスターマシン$$ belonged with a child like you.」

449:t_2:11.en:
$$カシオ$$
「That it would make both you and the $$バスターマシン$$ happy...」

449:t_2:12.en:
$$カシオ$$
「But that's wrong. Piloting a $$バスターマシン$$ is terrifying. Once you pilot one, it takes your heart captive.」

449:t_2:14.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Is it truly what you need right now...? I don't think so, and neither does $$ラルク$$...」

449:t_2:15.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Are you saying Big Sis thinks $$ノノ$$ doesn't need a $$バスターマシン$$...!?」

449:t_2:16.en:
$$カシオ$$
「I think $$ラルク$$ wants something quite different from you...」

449:t_2:17.en:
$$カシオ$$
「But $$バスターマシン$$s are all we have! Without that power, we can't even find a reason to live! I'm sure that $$ノノリリ$$ was the same!」

449:t_2:19.en:
$$カシオ$$
「I don't want to lie to myself anymore! I've pretended to reach $$あがり$$ and kept hiding who I am, but I'm still a $$トップレス$$!」

449:t_2:21.en:
$$カシオ$$
「Let's do this, $$トラントロワ$$! Our new battle begins this very moment! $$エキゾチックマニューバ$$!」

449:t_2:23.en:
$$カシオ$$
「$$エキゾチックマニューバ$$!!」

449:t_2:24.en:
$$カシオ$$
「$$エキゾチックマニューバ$$!!!!!!」

449:t_2:26.en:
$$カシオ$$
「...I knew it... It's no use...」

449:t_2:27.en:
$$カシオ$$
「I knew... all along... that I'd reached $$あがり$$ long ago...」

449:t_2:30.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I can hear Big Sis's voice...」

449:t_2:31.en:
$$カシオ$$
「What are you talking about...? Even with all this ether, there's no way we'd hear a battle on the other side of the moon.」

449:t_2:32.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But I can hear her! Big Sis is calling for help!!」

449:t_3:3.en: ～ $$トップレス$$ $$タイタン$$ Base $$サーペンタイン姉妹$$' Room ～

449:t_3:4.en:
$$ルクルト$$
「...$$ニコラス・バセロン$$ has sent us some more interesting data.」

449:t_3:5.en:
$$ピアジェ$$
「I doubt its activation is unrelated either.」

449:t_3:6.en:
$$ルクルト$$
「As I thought, the livelier they are, the better they work, wouldn't you say?」

449:t_3:7.en:
$$ピアジェ$$
「Yes. In that case, let's have more and more of their friends come to the solar system.」

449:t_3:9.en:
$$ピアジェ$$
「I'm sure its power will grant us eternity...」

449:t_3:12.en:
$$ルクルト$$
「Soon, this dinner will be a full-course meal.」

449:t_3:13.en:
$$ピアジェ$$
「Then let us eat, and pray for our future.」

449:t_3:20.en:
$$カレン$$
「$$ノノ$$'s back to her old self!」

449:t_3:21.en:
$$チコ$$
「Just what is that $$バスターマシン７号$$!?」

449:t_3:22.en:
$$アルト$$
「So those $$太陽系限定種$$ aren't our enemies after all!?」

449:t_3:23.en:
$$勝平$$
「Or rather, are they on Sis $$ノノ$$'s side!?」

449:t_3:24.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Ah...! If you all talk at once like that, $$ノノ$$'s head will burst!」

449:t_3:25.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Then explain it properly so everyone understands.」

449:t_3:29.en:
$$ノノ$$
「...$$ノノ$$ doesn't really understand either.」

449:t_3:30.en:
$n
「What the hell is that supposed to mean!?」

449:t_3:31.en:
$$宗介$$
「Calm down, $n. It is $$ノノ$$, after all.」

449:t_3:32.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Ah, it hurts when you put it like that...」

449:t_3:33.en:
$$チコ$$
「You... Have you ever heard the words 'you brought this on yourself'?」

449:t_3:35.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「For now, tell us what happened in order. You were on the moon, right?」

449:t_3:36.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes. I was searching for a $$バスターマシン$$ with $$カシオ$$ on the far side of the moon...」

449:t_3:37.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Then I heard Big Sis's voice, and the next thing I knew, I was there.」

449:t_3:38.en:
$$甲児$$
「$$カシオ$$'s apparently heading here too. He says it looked like $$ノノ$$ warped...」

449:t_3:39.en:
$$赤木$$
「So your hidden power awakened to save $$ラルク$$ when she was in trouble!」

449:t_3:41.en:
$$ノノ$$
「To save Big Sis from danger, $$ノノ$$ finally reveals her true form...! It's the very return of a champion of justice!」
